name: OneDrive
description: Find files and folders, and transfer files directly between OneDrive and the bot box.

setup.title: Connect OneDrive
setup.description: Configure a Microsoft Entra OAuth application for personal or work accounts, then sign in.
steps: Configure an HTTPS OpenTeam address using Tailscale Serve or your own domain. This integration uses a Web application callback; manual callback paste is not available.
Register a Microsoft Entra application with the supported account types you need.
Add the exact OpenTeam callback URL as a Web redirect URI.
Add delegated Files.ReadWrite, User.Read and offline_access permissions. Save the client ID and secret, then sign in.

fields.label: OAuth client secret
fields.helpText: Stored by your self-hosted OpenTeam server and never returned to the desktop app.

installationSteps: Install the plugin from the registry.
Complete the provider app setup in account settings, then save the credentials.
Authorize the account and wait for tool discovery to confirm Connected.
Enable the plugin and account for the Bots that need it.
